available.quote: The regulatory boards may enter into agreements with other jurisdictions for the recognition of certificates and licenses issued by other jurisdictions.

requirements.value: Board may recognize licenses or certificates issued by other states as full or partial fulfillment of qualifications; universal license recognition available for those holding a valid license in another state for at least 3 years who passed an examination and met education/training/experience standards, are in good standing, and have no disqualifying criminal record.
requirements.quote: the regulatory boards within the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation shall, upon application by an individual, recognize licenses or certificates issued by another state as fulfillment of qualifications for licensure or government certification in the Commonwealth

regulatory_model.quote: "Licensure" means a method of regulation whereby the Commonwealth, through the issuance of a license, authorizes a person possessing the character and minimum skills to engage in the practice of a profession or occupation that is unlawful to practice without a license.
regulatory_model.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 3 - Department of Professional and Occupational Regu

definition_quote.value: The 'practice of architecture' means any service wherein the principles and methods of architecture are applied, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design, and includes the responsible administration of construction contracts, in connection with any private or public buildings, structures or projects, or the related equipment or accessories.
definition_quote.quote: The "practice of architecture" means any service wherein the principles and methods of architecture are applied, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design, and includes the responsible administration of construction contracts, in connection with any private or public buildings, structures or projects, or the related equipment or accessories.

methods_authorized.quote: any service wherein the principles and methods of architecture are applied, such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design, and includes the responsible administration of construction contracts

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: "Certified interior designer" means a design professional who meets the criteria of education, experience, and testing in the rendering of interior design services established by the Board through certification as an interior designer.

interior_design_services_defined.quote: "Interior design" by a certified interior designer means any service rendered wherein the principles and methodology of interior design are applied in connection with the identification, research, and creative solution of problems pertaining to the function and quality of the interior environment.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: Any person who willfully engages in any unlawful act enumerated in this section is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_s.value: Class 6 felony (third or subsequent conviction within 36-month period)
unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_s.quote: The third or any subsequent conviction for violating this section during a 36-month period constitutes a Class 6 felony.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: recover a civil penalty of at least $200 but not more than $5,000 per violation, with each unlawful act constituting a separate violation; but in no event shall the civil penalties against any one person, partnership, corporation or other entity exceed $25,000 per year
